items.behavior: Opening the native Quick Panel presents Quick Access as the selected tab.

falsifier.observation: The native popup initially displays a different tab.
falsifier.probeMethod: Open the popup through its native command and inspect the initial active search surface.

items.behavior: Pressing Escape while a conversation is open leaves the native launcher visible.

falsifier.observation: The native launcher becomes hidden when Escape dismisses its open conversation.
falsifier.probeMethod: Open a conversation in the native popup, press Escape and read native window visibility.

items.behavior: Selecting a search result displays the preview for that result's canonical identity.

falsifier.observation: The preview belongs to a different result than the selected result.
falsifier.probeMethod: Select plans, agents and reports with distinct canonical identities in the registered launcher component tests.
